[EN] While you've been slaughtering everything that moves, I've been compiling a report of what we've learned and the good we've done.

Report back to the commander. I don't want her thinking I've been loafing on the job.
[ES] Mientras has estado masacrando todo lo que se mueve, he estado recopilando un informe de lo que hemos aprendido y del bien que hemos hecho.

Preséntale un informe al comandante. No quiero que piense que he estado flojeando en el trabajo.

[EN] Well, there's no dross in you. Did you actually read this report?

It's page after page of " killed this" and " killed that."

Impressive. Bloody, but impressive.
[ES] Bueno, no hay escoria en ti. ¿De verdad leíste este informe?

Son páginas y páginas de " mató esto" y " mató aquello".

Impresionante. Sangriento, pero impresionante.
